snippet.title: DEADLY NIGHT - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
DEADLY NIGHT is a single player, 80's slasher movie brought to life as a video game. 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2026880/Deadly_Night/
Itchio: https://torturestar.itch.io/deadly-night

Prepare to feel helpless as you are stalked by one relentless killer with an insatiable bloodlust at a lonely motel! Developed by Cubyte games

Out now!
